---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
description: Documentation conventions for repository Markdown.
---

Use Australian English. Prefer direct technical prose, concrete examples, and headings that make the document skimmable.

When behaviour, interfaces, deployment, configuration, or operator actions change, update the relevant documentation in the same change or explain why it is unnecessary.

Do not duplicate a source of truth merely to make documentation appear complete. Link or generate where duplication would drift.
